cards.question: What does an atomic operation guarantee?
cards.answer: It either occurs or does not; there is no half-done state. Two threads can update an AtomicI32 without both reading the same value and writing at once.

cards.question: Why is there no Atomic<T>?
cards.answer: Rust only provides concrete types such as AtomicBool and AtomicI32, up to the word size (AtomicUsize).

cards.question: What limits which atomic types exist?
cards.answer: The implementation of atomics and which ones are available depends on the system architecture and OS.
